acceptanceCriteriaVerified: AC1: Given a full public build, when crawling the live site, then no routes or links pointing to /admin or containing system tags are reachable.
AC2: Given the UI, when visually inspected, then the layout adheres to the strict monochromatic design without popups.

AC3: Given automated accessibility checks, when run on the public facade, then all UI views meet WCAG 2.1 AA compliance (keyboard operability, visible focus, labelled form controls, 4.5:1 text contrast).
notes: Created public-facade-isolation.spec.ts for QA verification of black-box public facade isolation, monochromatic design, and automated WCAG 2.1 AA compliance. All 24 Playwright tests in frontend passed cleanly.
